content.methodology: Cálculo de capitalización acumulada durante los años restantes hasta la jubilación: Años = Edad Retiro - Edad Actual.
content.methodology_en: Accumulated growth compounding calculation during remaining work years: Years = Target Age - Current Age.

guideSections.title: Retirement Planning & 401(k) Basics
guideSections.content_html_en: A 401(k) or personal pension plan allows workers to save and invest a portion of their paycheck before or after taxes. Compounding over decades builds a comfortable retirement nest egg.
guideSections.content_html: Un plan 401(k) o fondo de pensiones permite invertir una parte del salario mensual disfrutando de ventajas fiscales para acumular un fondo de retiro holgado.

guideSections.title: Employer Matching Free Money
guideSections.content_html_en: Many employers match employee contributions up to a certain percentage (e.g. 50% match up to 6% salary). Always contribute at least enough to capture the full match—it is literally free money.
guideSections.content_html: Muchas empresas aportan un porcentaje complementario sobre lo que tú inviertes. Es recomendable aportar lo suficiente para aprovechar el 100% de la contribución empresarial.

guideSections.title: The 4% Safe Withdrawal Rule
guideSections.title_es: La Regla del 4% de Retiro Seguro
guideSections.content_html_en: The 4% rule states that you can withdraw 4% of your total retirement savings in your first year of retirement (adjusted for inflation thereafter) with a high probability of not outliving your money for 30 years.
guideSections.content_html: La regla del 4% sugiere que puedes retirar el 4% de tu fondo acumulado en el primer año de jubilación manteniendo el capital durante 30 años sin agotarlo.
